name: Itch-io
description: Browse and download GB/GBC games from Itch.io's GB Studio collection.
author: Carroarmato0

changelog.v1.0.20: • Fix games being wrongly marked as removed after a version update was published.
changelog.v1.0.19:
• Add gbstudio tag to find more GB games.
• Fix nested zip archives from being recognized as candidate roms.
changelog.v1.0.17:
• UI overhaul.
• New Search, Filter/Sort functionality.
• Virtual Keyboad.
• Support for PICO-8.
changelog.v1.0.16:
• Multi-platform support (GB/GBC/GBA/NES/GENESIS).
• Allow cancelling Gamelist update.
• Various UI and performance fixes.
changelog.v1.0.15:
• Smart zip file support and extraction logic.
• Download game soundtracks when available.
• Add GBA support.
• Fix parsing Free/Paid games with currency symbol at the end of price.
changelog.v1.0.14: • Use L1/R1 for cycling between sorting. Always go back to the top of the list.
changelog.v1.0.13:
• Fast scrolling with L1/R1 and Left/Right.
• Emoji support.
• Single game list scrolling.
• Instructions for adding API Key in Settings.
• Fix some UI issues.
• New sorting for owned games.
• Use HTTP/2 for better connection management.
changelog.v1.0.12:
• Some minor fixes from previous release.
• New screenshots.
changelog.v1.0.11:
• Support NextUI themeing settings.
• UI overhaul.
• Performance optimizations.
• Unified Naming.
• Fix update-service and DL/Update game list consistency.
• Improve scrolling.
• Game info and cover-art only fetched for selected game, with pre-cache warmup of games in the vicinity of selection.
changelog.v1.0.10:
• Add support for Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Devanagari, Greek, and many more non-CJK fonts.
• Fix issue preventing to exit the app when Cloudflare blocks the connection.
• Rewrite of the build system to leverage NextUI's own toolchains, allowing the use of the native SDL library on the devices and reducing the size of the Pak.
• Some UI fixes.
• Fix launching on Miyoo Flip and TrimUI Smart Pro S.
• Support GIFs in cover art.
• New Inventory system for tracking downloaded ROMs, game updates and store removals.
• New Sorting category [DL] = Download, with Update section.
• Implement Power Control (standby and poweroff).
• Countermeasures for the "double input" hardware bug on my355.
• Log rotation.
changelog.v1.0.10-rc4:
• Implement Power Control (wakeup/poweroff).
• Fix double d-pad input on my355.
changelog.v1.0.10-rc3:
• Support GIFs in cover art.
• Enhance inventory for tracking game updates or store removal.
changelog.v1.0.10-rc2:
• Fix some UI issues.
• Prevent double input on my355.
changelog.v1.0.10-rc1:
• Add support for Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Devanagari, Greek, and many more non-CJK fonts.
• Allow exiting the Pak when Cloudflare is blocking the initial fetching of the game list.
• Rewrite build and release to use NextUI toolchains and switch to native SDL on device.
changelog.v1.0.9: Implement basic sorting in Game List.
changelog.v1.0.8: Fix the +50 owned games issue when the API returns an empty page response because there are not 51 games.
changelog.v1.0.7:
• Advanced logging.
• API key testing.
• Game inventory.
• File management.
• Purchase picker for games bought multiple times (individual and bundle).
• Shows bundle names in picker.
• Faster game detail scrolling.
• Fix cover art not shown properly.
changelog.v1.0.6:
• More robust handling of Cloudflare checks.
• Improved cover art download.
• Handle game page with .zip filenames.
changelog.v1.0.5:
• Transparent game list caching.
• Better scrolling in general.
• Support Asian fonts through Noto Sans JP.
changelog.v1.0.4:
• Add advanced logging.
• Privacy obfuscation in logs.
• User agent string.
changelog.v1.0.3: Support alternative ROM location per file-type.
changelog.v1.0.2:
• Place app logs in correct folder location.
• Fix scripts and in-app version.
changelog.v1.0.0: Initial release — browse and download free and paid GB/GBC games from itch.io's GB Studio collection, with built-in content filters.
